versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the PubMed clinical literature retrieval and analysis skill.
- Supports advanced PubMed literature searches with MeSH term expansion, synonym recognition, and user-confirmed search strategies.
- Integrates JCR 2025 journal ranking data for impact factor and quartile filtering, including custom local overrides.
- Provides comprehensive sorting by relevance, journal ranking, and recency, with adjustable weights and filtering options.
- Outputs structured reports with Top 10 recommendations, research type and journal distribution, and trend analyses.
- Enables workflow adjustments for time range, journal ranking, research type, and sorting methods.
